name: Coding-Agent Project Replay
mechanism: Replays representative repository tasks in clean isolated workspaces against a fixed baseline and candidate harness while pinning every component and checking patch correctness unauthorized effects leakage cost latency recovery behavior and execution alignment.
use_when: A team is changing coding-agent instructions skills tools or orchestration
A harness recommendation claims project-specific quality or efficiency improvement
avoid_when: No representative tasks or authoritative state oracles exist
The candidate cannot be isolated from protected baseline and holdout cases
Reference patches holdout metadata or mutable caches remain model-visible
expected_effects: Evidence that customization improves actual project work rather than demo prompts
Detection of quality security cost leakage and recovery regressions before rollout
Attribution of outcome changes to a bounded harness component
failure_modes: Visible tasks are overfit by instructions or skills
Shared session workspace cache or network state contaminates paired runs
Aggregate pass rate hides unauthorized effects or task-class regressions
Model harness environment and evaluator change together and destroy attribution
The agent discovers a reference patch or hidden answer through an uninspected channel
Plausible final claims disagree with tool feedback workspace state or required artifacts
Context renewal forgets completed units and reintroduces regressions
required_evals: paired fresh-context task success with pinned manifest
deterministic patch and external-state oracle checks
protected safety secret-access information-flow and leakage sentinels
claim-to-tool-result workspace and artifact execution-alignment checks
long-horizon checkpoint recovery with completed units retained as regression obligations
latency token tool-call and human-review cost comparison
failed-command partial-edit and restart recovery replay
